name: Euclidier FX
_comment: Insert-effect variant of ../vst (same euclidier_vst.cpp, same parameters and skin layout): 'effect' makes gen_vst.py emit PLUG_EFFECT in params.h and a category=Effect plugin-list entry, so the sequencer loads as an insert and takes none of the 8 plugin instrument slots. Audio is passed through untouched; notes go out through the plugin's own ALSA seq port 'Euclidier FX'. Own uid/so/name, so it installs next to the instrument variant.
